Paper Name: Techno-economic feasibility and performance analysis of an islanded hybrid renewable energy system with hydrogen storage in Morocco
NOTES: System: Wind/Fuel Cell/Diesel (no PV). Wind turbine: Enercon E40 600/46, rated 600 kW. 5 diesel generators each 300 kW (total 1500 kW). Fuel cell: 300 kW. Electrolyzer: 500 kW. H2 storage: compressed gas at 200 bar (max 400 bar), 50 m3 tank. Project lifetime: 20 years. Discount rate: 9.3%. LCOE = NPVCost/NPVProduction = $0.0701/kWh. Annual load inferred: 7680 kWh/day * 365 = 2,803,200 kWh/yr. Renewable fraction: 44.57%. No PV. No LPSP reported. No emission factors. No diesel constants f_0/f_1. No H2_LHV. No v_cut_in. eta_FC=56.6%% (page 11). Diesel lifetime: 15,000 h. Converter lifetime: 15 yrs. Wind/Fuel cell/Electrolyzer/H2 storage lifetime: 20 yrs. Off-grid (no p_grid). N_WT=1 assumed. c_PV used for wind turbine ($1300/kW).
